name: '90s Throwback
description: Mid-'90s Saturday sports-show energy: Memphis squiggles and dots, teal, purple, magenta and yellow, chunky type with hard drop shadows. VHS-glitch transitions, a pager-style LCD scorebug, a holographic trading card and a dial-up replay stinger. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
